name: パステルピンク
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.4); margin: 0 !important; }
.simple-ring { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; }

.center-macaron { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 110px; height: 110px; z-index: 15; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff0f5 0%, #ffb6c1 100%); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 105, 180, 0.3), inset 0 2px 5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); pointer-events: none; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }
.macaron-cream { width: 120px; height: 120px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #ffffff; position: absolute; opacity: 0.6; }

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 50px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 20; pointer-events: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 5px rgba(255, 105, 180, 0.4)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }

.pointer-top { width: 30px; height: 30px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fff0f5, #ffb6c1); border: 2px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; margin-bottom: 2px; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.3); }

.pointer-arrow { width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 10px solid transparent; border-right: 10px solid transparent; border-top: 18px solid #ff99ac; margin-top: -2px; /* 軸との接続調整 */ filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 0 #ffffff); position: relative; }

.pointer-arrow::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -20px; left: -10px; width: 20px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50% / 0 0 100% 100%; background: #ff99ac; transform: scaleX(1.1); /* 矢印の付け根を少し広げる */ z-index: -1; }

#spinBtn { position: absolute; top: 570px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 220px; height: 70px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffb6c1 0%, #ff99ac 100%); border: 4px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 15px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.6); transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 2px; font-family: 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Arial', sans-serif; }

#result { position: absolute; top: 650px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff99ac; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #ffffff; font-family: 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Arial', sans-serif; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #ffb6c1 !important; }
